name: Cup-a-Soup Tomato Chatpata
ingredients_raw: Sugar, potato starch, bread croutons (13%) (refined wheat flour (maida), hydrogenated palm oil, seasoning, iodised salt, yeast, rosemary extract), maltodextrin, iodised salt, tomato paste solids (7.0%), dehydrated vegetables (onion powder, garlic powder, leeks), hydrolyzed vegetable protein, hydrogenated palm oil, thickeners (415 & 412), acidity regulator (330), red beet juice powder (anti caking agent (551)), anti caking agent (551), nature identical flavouring substances, spices & condiments, spice oleoresin, flavour enhancers (627 & 631).
